title: This 6-million-year-old whale may have had the most crooked face in mammal history
caption:
Meet Scaphokogia huachafo, a 6-million-year-old whale with the most asymmetrical face ever seen in a mammal. Far from being a deformity, this extreme, crooked skull was a specialized tool for hunting on the seafloor.

Source: Sciencedaily - This 6-million-year-old whale may have had the most crooked face in mammal history
